decisions.reason: The source changes 3D-model reference paths, not the L1 footprint-library resolution or physical-footprint requirement.
Relative 3D-model paths do not change the required content or correctness of the sensor-board BOM.
The path-portability correction does not change the integrated-board architecture, connector strategy, component-selection policy, or cost goal.
The source concerns KiCad 3D-model references and does not modify any power-board BOM or assembly-readiness attribute.
Changing 3D-model paths does not affect the decision to use through-hole connectors.
Although both concern the integrated-board project package, the source does not change the integrated-board BOM deliverable or its completeness.
The source does not alter the legacy main-board BOM, parts-list completeness, or optional connector population.
The integrated-board 3D-model path policy does not change the required sensor-board fabrication and placement exports.
The KiCad 3D-model reference correction has no effect on the 5V boost rail, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
The source does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement.
The 3D-model path policy does not alter the panel power-button connector, location, signal, or control behavior.
The source does not change the sensor connector set, fanout role, consolidation policy, or removal of interboard connectors.
